TAVI Desk go-live: Wave 1, organisation and access

First run 1–2 Nov 2026 on Anyware-Staging (owner, UI + API). The open cases were rerun on 2 Nov on NDC-Staging (Wonder Travel tenant) with an owner, a Desk Agent and a Desk Supervisor; Anyware-Staging is now paused. Compared with Zoho Desk Enterprise (help centre + live trial org techsolutionsegypt). Covers inventory rows O-01..O-05, A-01..A-09 and Q-04. Wave 1 is closed: 4 bugs filed (NDC-2776..2779), NDC-2303 and NDC-2387 moved to Done.

Bug drafts (not filed)

W1-B1Low

NDC-2776 · Company profile | A long phone number gives "An unexpected error occurred", and the API saves any phone or website

Cases
W1-04
Where
Setup › General › Company › Edit; API PUT /iam/tenant/company-profile

Steps

  1. Open Setup › Company and press Edit.
  2. Type a 300-digit number in Phone and press Save.
  3. Edit again, type a 40-digit number in Phone and press Save.
  4. By API, PUT /iam/tenant/company-profile with website "not a url".

Expected

Phone is limited to a sensible length (Zoho Desk: 20 characters) and checked on the server too; the website is checked by the server as it is on screen. No server error.

Actual

300 digits: toast "An unexpected error occurred." (HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR), nothing saved. 40 digits: saved. Website: the screen refuses "not a url" ("Enter a valid website URL", Save disabled), but the API saves it (200). Reproduced on Anyware (API) and NDC-Staging (screen + API); values set back each time.

Request and response (from the run, ids shortened)

PUT /iam/tenant/company-profile {…, "website": "not a url"}  →  200, website saved as "not a url"
PUT /iam/tenant/company-profile {…, "phone": "<40 digits>"}  →  200
PUT /iam/tenant/company-profile {…, "phone": "<300 digits>"}  →  500 {"code":"INTERNAL_ERROR","message":"An unexpected error occurred."}

Zoho Desk

Checked on the Zoho trial org: the Phone field stops at 20 characters (maxlength 20) and saves with no error; the Website field has no format check (saved "http://not a url", 50 characters max). Both were set back right away.

Evidence

Annotated image below (TAVI left, Zoho right). Raw: evidence/raw/bugs/W1-B1-*.png, zoho-B1-*.png; API output wave1/raw/w1-a.json, w1-l.json, ndc/raw/n-e3.json.

W1-B2Medium

NDC-2777 · Departments | Saving a department from an older copy of the page silently undoes another admin's change

Cases
W1-27
Where
Setup › General › Departments › edit department; API PATCH /desk/departments/{id}

Steps

  1. Open the same department (Setup › Departments) in two tabs, A and B.
  2. In tab A untick "Allow copied addresses (CC) on tickets" and press Save.
  3. In tab B (still showing CC ticked) type a "Display Name in Help Center" and press Save.
  4. Reload the department.

Expected

Tab B is told the department changed since it was opened ("Reload to see the latest") and nothing is overwritten. The same protection is asked for on modules and layouts in NDC-2238 / NDC-2241.

Actual

Tab B saves without any message and CC is back on; tab A's change is lost. The department has no version check (GET has no version field, PATCH takes no If-Match). Reproduced 3 times: twice by API on Anyware, once on screen on NDC-Staging.

Request and response (from the run, ids shortened)

PATCH /desk/departments/<qa dept> {… "cc_enabled": false}  →  200 (tab A)
PATCH /desk/departments/<qa dept> {… "cc_enabled": true, "description": "QA GL changed in tab B"}  →  200 (tab B, stale)
GET  /desk/departments/<qa dept>  →  cc_enabled: true, description: "QA GL changed in tab B"

Zoho Desk

Not checked: in the Zoho trial org the department edit form does not save ("Unable to process your request"), so the two-tab test could not run. Nothing was changed in Zoho.

Evidence

Annotated image below. Raw screens evidence/raw/bugs/W1-B2-1..5-*.png, API output wave1/raw/w1-c2.json, w1-k.json, ndc/raw/n-b2.json.

W1-B3Medium

NDC-2778 · Agents | Inviting an email that already belongs to an active user creates a second, pending user for the same email

Cases
W1-30 (NDC rerun)
Where
Setup › User Management › Agents › Invite user; API POST /iam/users/invite

Steps

  1. Pick a user who is active but has no Desk profile (mmohamed@anyware.software, CRM Admin).
  2. Invite that email as Desk Agent.
  3. Open All Agents and search for the email; look at GET /iam/users.

Expected

The existing user gets the Desk profile, or the invite is refused ("already a user"). One email = one user.

Actual

Accepted with no warning. Agents shows a new Pending · Desk Agent · Invited row; /iam/users has two rows for the email (Invited / Desk Agent with empty user id, and the active CRM Admin). The test invitation was cancelled.

Request and response (from the run, ids shortened)

POST /iam/users/invite {email: mmohamed@anyware.software, profile: Desk Agent}  →  200
GET /iam/users  →  [Invited · Desk Agent · userId 00000000…], [active · CRM Admin · 7e5e7c27…]

Zoho Desk

The New Agent form takes an existing agent's email with no message while typing; Zoho checks only on Save, which was not pressed — final behaviour not checked.

Evidence

Annotated image below. Raw: evidence/raw/bugs/W1-B3-2-agents-invited-row.png, W1-B3-3-api-two-rows.png, zoho-B3-3-existing-email-typed.png; API output ndc/raw/n-f1.json.

W1-B4Low

NDC-2779 · Audit Log | Saving the company profile logs "time zone from blank value to UTC" although the time zone was not changed

Cases
W1-04 audit note (NDC rerun)
Where
Setup › Audit Log; Setup › Company; API GET /iam/tenant/company-profile

Steps

  1. Setup › Company › Edit, change only Website or Phone, Save.
  2. Open Setup › Audit Log.
  3. Open Setup › Company and read Time zone.

Expected

Only the changed fields are logged; no time zone entry when the time zone was not touched.

Actual

Audit Log: "updated Wonder Travel's time zone from blank value to UTC" next to each website save; the Company page still shows Africa/Cairo. The API read the same unchanged record once as UTC (version 0) and then as Africa/Cairo (version 1).

Request and response (from the run, ids shortened)

GET /iam/tenant/company-profile (×3, nothing saved)  →  UTC/v0, Africa/Cairo/v1, Africa/Cairo/v1 — same updated_at

Zoho Desk

Zoho's Audit Log has no entry for the company edits made the same day, so a time zone entry cannot be compared.

Evidence

Annotated image below. Raw: evidence/raw/bugs/W1-B4-1-audit-list.png, W1-B4-3-company-page.png, zoho-B4-1-audit.png; API ndc/raw/n-f2.json, n-f4.json.

Gaps against Zoho found in this wave

  • Overnight business hours (new): a time block that runs past midnight is refused with "slots cannot cross midnight". Two blocks in one day work (Mon 09–13 + 14–18 saved). Zoho allows overnight blocks (help: "Multi-blocks in Business Hours"). Added to the gap ticket draft as item 4.
  • Personal time zone and date format: still missing. My Profile › Account information has name, alias, date of birth, contact and address only. Already filed: NDC-1970.
  • Agent sign-in security: still missing. No page for SSO/SAML, two-factor, an IP allow list or a password policy. Already filed: NDC-1977.

Known Plane tickets

  • NDC-2303 → Done (2 Nov): a Tech-only Desk Supervisor is refused (403) at Read only and Restricted, priority unchanged; Full access allowed. Comment + image posted.
  • NDC-2387 → Done (2 Nov): hidden and read-only on a required field are both refused (422) with clear messages; nothing stored. Comment + image posted.
  • NDC-2305 passes (Anyware run, 1 Nov). Not moved, no comment (was In Progress).
  • Still In Progress, not retested: NDC-2736, NDC-2733.
  • Seen in passing: the Anyware invite refusal returns the raw key iam.subscription.seat_limit_reached (like CRM NDC-2658).

Inconclusive and not run

  • None left open. Every case that was inconclusive or not run on Anyware was rerun on NDC-Staging (table above), and all passed.
